instruction: There's a document on the Desktop with extension recommendations from an expert. Install all the Chrome plugins mentioned in that document.

expected: Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing all 5 Chrome extensions from the expert's recommendation document. Evaluator verifies all expected extensions are installed by checking Chrome preferences.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts extension names from Chrome Preferences file (extensions.settings[id].manifest.name)
Metric logic correctly uses subset comparison to verify all expected extensions are installed
Complete coverage: evaluator checks all 5 required extensions from the instruction
Data flow is semantically correct: extension names (strings) extracted and compared appropriately
Evaluator correctly allows additional extensions to be installed beyond the required ones
Edge cases handled: getter returns empty list if no extensions, metric returns 0.0 for None/empty input
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor risk: Extension names must match exactly as stored in Chrome manifest. Consider adding fuzzy matching or checking both display name and manifest name if exact matching causes false negatives
The static warning about UI-dependent state is not applicable here - the getter reads from persistent Chrome Preferences file, not UI state, so no postconfig is needed
